name: Jellyfin VR Player
overview: Play 180°, 360°, fisheye and stereo videos in WebXR.
description: Adds a VR button to Jellyfin Web's player controls. Supports 180°/360°, fisheye, flat cinema, SBS/OU stereo, controller input, seeking, zoom and H.264 compatibility streams. Installs its own web injection middleware and serves all JavaScript locally.
changelog: Initial server plugin release with local assets, automatic web injection and menu-only VR entry.
